units.source_text: 我並不直接認識寫下這篇手記的瘋子，但我認識跟手記中的登場人物雷同的、京橋小酒館的老闆娘。

en.t: I did not know the madman who wrote these notes directly, but I did know the proprietress of a small bar in Kyobashi, who seemed much like one of the people appearing in them.

units.source_text: 她身材嬌小，氣色欠佳，長著細長的丹鳳眼，挺著高鼻樑，與其說是一個美人，不如說更像帶給人一種硬派感覺的俊美青年。

en.t: She was petite and pale, with long narrow upturned eyes and a high nose; rather than a beauty, she seemed more like a handsome young man with a stern, hard-edged air.

units.source_text: 這篇手記好像主要描寫昭和五年至七年間的東京風情。

en.t: These notes seem mainly to depict the atmosphere of Tokyo from around Showa 5 to Showa 7.

units.source_text: 那家京橋的小酒館，我被朋友帶去過兩三次，在那裡喝過Highball[1]，

en.t: As for that small bar in Kyobashi, friends had taken me there two or three times, and I had drunk highballs there.

units.source_text: 當時是昭和十年前後，也就是日本的「軍部」不加掩飾即將日益猖獗的時候。

en.t: That was around Showa 10, a time when Japan's military faction was about to begin rampaging ever more openly.

units.source_text: 所以，我不可能有機會認識寫下這篇手記的那個男人。

en.t: For that reason, I could not have had any chance to know the man who wrote these notes.
